title: Anthropic Residency: applications open for established technical leaders
summary: Anthropic Residency: applications open for established technical leaders Alignment Science Blog Anthropic Residency: applications open for established technical leaders Today we are opening applications for the Anthropic Residency, our paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making AI systems safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder, or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required. Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026. Apply here (US) or here (UK) . Why we’re opening this round Machine learning is a young field. Many of today’s senior researchers, including many at Anthropic, started out as physicists, mathematicians, neuroscientists, or software engineers. As model capabilities improve, what matters most in AI research is increasingly the ability to frame a research agenda and judge what is worth doing. Senior people in quantitative fields often already excel at these skills; the Residency helps them build the understanding of frontier AI they need to apply those skills in this new field.
